# Carousel Twelve — Tasks & Design Notes

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib **Carousel 12** (`carousel-12`), implemented under the new app name `carousel-twelve`.

## Section Structure & Order

1. **Navbar / Header**: Minimal branding with navigation links and search/cta.
2. **Hero Carousel Section**: Primary interactive slider component featuring slides with background images, prominent typography, descriptions, and call-to-action buttons.
3. **Features / Highlights Section**: Secondary info cards detailing features associated with the carousel items.
4. **Call to Action Section**: Engaging banner inviting users to explore more templates.
5. **Footer**: Clean copyright and mandatory link to [Component Dock](https://www.componentdock.com/).

## Design & Fidelity Notes

- **Colors**: Rich slate backgrounds combined with vibrant blue accents (`#007bff`).
- **Assets**: Deterministic placeholder images via `https://picsum.photos/seed/carousel-twelve-<n>/1200/800`.
- **Interactivity**: Fully accessible keyboard-navigable and clickable slide controls with state management.
